newsitem.title: INDIA: Honda says no plan to raise stake in Indian unit.
newsitem.headline: Honda says no plan to raise stake in Indian unit.

text.p: Japan's Honda Motors Co Ltd has no plans to increase its equity holding in India's Hero Honda Motors Ltd, senior company officials said on Thursday.
"We have no plans to change the equity conditions," T. Nakajima, joint managing director of Hero Honda Motors Ltd, told a news conference.
Nakajima is Honda's representative in Hero Honda Motors Ltd. Honda Motor Co Ltd and Hero Motors hold 26 percent each in the joint venture. The balance is with the public, officials said.

Hero Motors, controlled by India's Munjal family, signed a technical agreement in 1984 that gave the group access to Honda Motor Co Ltd's technology to make light motorcycles. The joint venture was called Hero Honda.
Brijmohan Lall Munjal, chairman and managing director of Hero Honda said: "We are all satisfied with the present conditions".
Hero Honda Motors Ltd on Thursday launched the 100 cc Street motorcycle in India.
"This motorcycle has been launched keeping in mind the needs of the Indian customer and the condition of the roads," Hero Honda director Pawan Munjal told a news conference.
The price of the Street motorcycle has not been fixed yet, he added.
Hero Honda said it had invested 1.8 billion rupees in a new plant, on the outskirts of the Indian capital, that will begin producing the Street motorcycle.

"Fifty percent of the funds invested was raised through overseas commercial borrowings and the remaining fifty percent was raised through internal accruals," said P. Dasgupta, Hero Honda's senior Vice-President (Finance).

Pawan Munjal said the new plant has an annual production capacity of 300,000 motorcycles. Initially the factory will manufacture 100,000 a year, he said, without indicating how long that production level would be maintained.
"This new facility will commence production on January 24, 1997, to roll out the first Street manufactured in India," Munjal said earlier in a statement.
